description: PAID $0.005 USDC. APY (7-day on-chain exchange-rate change), TVL and exchange rate for stETH, rETH, cbETH, weETH, sfrxETH, sUSDe, sUSDS and sDAI. Optional token filter. Returns JSON APY, TVL, and exchange rate for the eight documented LST and yield-bearing tokens, or the one token requested.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

token.description: Optional symbol filter. Format: one of stETH, rETH, cbETH, weETH, sfrxETH, sUSDe, sUSDS, sDAI. Example: rETH. Omit for all eight.

name: staking_yields
title: Staking / LST yields ($0.005)
